newsitem.title: NORWAY: Norwegian shares flat ahead of weekend.
newsitem.headline: Norwegian shares flat ahead of weekend.

text.p: Norwegian shares were largerly flat on Friday in turnover inflated by trade for tax and other purposes, dealers said.
Oslo's Total share index closed 0.26 percent up at 1,109.33 points in dull business with many investors out of the market following the public holiday on Thursday.

Volume was a high 2.65 billion crowns, but dealers noted much of it had to do with foreign investors buying back shares in branded-goods conglomerate Orkla following a dividend payout of seven crowns per share on Friday.
Trade in Orkla amounted to 1.1 billion crowns. Foreign investors, because they pay tax on dividend, sell stock against an option to buy it back after the dividend payout.
Energy group Hafslund was the second most traded share at 673 million crowns, but dealers blamed the volume on Sweden's Vattenfall moving its holdings in Hafslund to a subsidiary.
